title: French Meme Song
blurb: The French meme song — that jaunty accordion-adjacent tune that turns any clip into a Parisian comedy. The internet uses it for moments of Continental absurdity: mimes, baguettes, elegant failures, and anyone being dramatically European. It's a whole aesthetic in eight seconds. Oui oui, press the button.
origin: The jaunty tune of French-flavored meme edits.
